name: Instrument of the Bards (Doss Lute)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Each once a day: Fly, Invisibility, Levitate, Protection from Evil and Good, Animal Friendship, Protection From Energy, Protection From Poison.
text: An Instrument of the Bards is superior to an ordinary instrument in every way. While playing it, a Bard can use it to cast each of these spells once, regaining the use at dawn: Fly, Invisibility, Levitate and Protection from Evil and Good, plus this instrument's own: Animal Friendship, Protection From Energy, Protection From Poison. When you use the instrument to cast a spell that causes targets to have the Charmed condition on a failed save, the targets have Disadvantage on the saving throw. A creature that tries to play it without being attuned must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 2d4 Psychic damage.
